name: Edge Defect
definition: For a finite binary class $C$, let $n_{i,b}(C)$ count its concepts with bit $b$ in coordinate $i$, and let $e(C)$ count pairs at Hamming distance one. The edge defect is $\eta(C)=\sum_i\min\{n_{i,0}(C),n_{i,1}(C)\}-e(C)$.
normalization: Coordinates are binary; constant coordinates contribute zero.
comments: Equivalently, this is the minimum over roots of the number of missing cube edges directed toward the root. It is nonincreasing under nonempty pc-minors and vanishes exactly on daisy cubes.
